createInvoice.a: Invoices page par jayein aur 'Add Invoice' par click karein ya kahin se bhi Shift+N shortcut use karein. Client aur items ki details bharein, phir save karein.

multipleStores.q: Kya main multiple stores manage kar sakta hoon?
multipleStores.a: Haan! Ek hi account se kai business stores banane aur manage karne ke liye sidebar (top section) mein store switcher ka use karein. Har store ki apni inventory aur customers hote hain.

voiceAI.q: Voice AI kaise kaam karta hai?
voiceAI.a: Customer ya Product page par microphone icon par click karein (ya Alt+V use karein). Details normal tareeke se bole (jaise, 'Add a customer Rahul from Delhi'), aur hamara AI aapke liye form fill kar dega.

exportData.q: Main apna data export kaise karu?
exportData.a: Zyadatar list pages par 'Download' button ya Ctrl+D shortcut hota hai. Aap apne requirements ke hisaab se data ko PDF, Excel ya CSV format mein export kar sakte hain.

lowStock.a: 'Stock' section mein, aap un products ko red highlight mein dekh sakte hain jo aapke set kiye gaye minimum quantity se kam hain.

gstReports.a: 'Analytics' > 'GST Analytics' par jayein. Yahan aap apni tax liabilities dekh sakte hain aur GSTR reports download kar sakte hain.

steps.addProducts: Inventory mein initial products add karein
steps.addUPI: Payments ke liye UPI ID add karein
